title: Riders Of Justice
desc: Markus goes home to his teenage daughter, Mathilde, when his wife dies in a train crash. All appears to be a tragic accident until a mathematics geek, who was also a fellow passenger on the train, and his two colleagues show up.

title: The Beast
desc: In the near future artificial intelligence is in control of everyone's lives where emotions have become a threat. Set across three different time periods 1910, 2014 and 2044. Our actress (Léa Seydoux) decides to purify her DNA in a machine & continually falls in love with different incarnations of Louis (George MacKay)

title: Out Of Death
desc: From the producers of The Irishman & Lone Survivor comes this thrilling story of Jack Harris (Bruce Willis) who must tap into his killer instincts to survive the wilderness and the human predators as he tries to help a woman who witnesses a crime and finds herself running from a rural mountain town's corrupt police department after she took a video of police killing a drug dealer.

title: The Catcher Was A Spy
desc: With an ensemble cast, this gripping, espionage thriller brings to life the true story of Moe Berg a World War II spy. His mission: go behind enemy lines in Europe to assassinate the Nazi's chief nuclear scientist before the Germans develop an atomic bomb. Berg must rely on his steel-trap intellect in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse - with the fate of the world hanging in the balance.

title: Motel Melati
desc: You are checked in for a Pleasant stay in our Motel Melati run by the mistress of the house, Madam Melati. Things are not as they seem, our century old cursed Motel lures unsuspecting travelers where they are confronted by their worst nightmares, never to be seen again. Come and learn Madam Melati’s secret and tortured history and the truth behind her bond with the Motel.
